tecnicas.observacao: Condição 3-shot comparada com a condição zero-shot para os mesmos modelos (GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, CodeLlama-7B-Instruct). O prompt inclui três exemplos de CSP#-PAT-84 selecionados por correspondência de categorias e tags (exemplos de código como demonstração -> exemplos e contexto) e regras de gramática derivadas do manual do PAT (documentação -> contexto). O estudo não informa se as regras de gramática G também estão no prompt zero-shot; por isso o contraste é tratado como pacote (exemplos, possivelmente com gramática) e o efeito não pode ser atribuído só aos exemplos. O texto dos prompts de avaliação não é apresentado; instrucao é atribuída pela condição zero-shot herdada. O estudo apresenta o few-shot também como linha de base (baselines) do benchmark, mas a conclusão destaca 'few-shot learning and grammar prompting' como achado.

citacoes.trecho: For both process generation and model generation tasks, the LLMs are evaluated in zero-shot and 3-shot settings.
To fully utilize the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, grammar rules G derived from the PAT manual and few-shot examples are also included in the prompt.
Examples are selected from CSP#-PAT-84, prioritizing those with matching categories and tags.
Moreover, we introduce NL2CSP, a multi-stage approach designed to improve the performance of LLMs in generating codes in CSP#.
NL2CSP leverages a combination of data augmentation, grammar-guided code synthesis, and in-context learning to improve the quality of the generated code.
We synthesize 5 million tokens of CSP code snippets and conduct continual pre-training on Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct to enhance its domain-specific knowledge of CSP code.
We compare the performance of NL2CSP with the base model, Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct, using a 3-shot setting.
This improvement can be attributed to the use of only syntactically correct training data for continual pre-training.

The experiment results demonstrated that, through few-shot learning and grammar prompting, GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-Coder could effectively extract key information from requirements and transform it into CSP code.
Similar to the process generation task, few-shot prompting consistently improves the results for all models except Code Llama.

While the 3-shot version generally performs better than the zero-shot version, manual inspection reveals that the Code Llama in the 3-shot setting tends to copy the provided examples into its generated output.
This behavior leads to improved Pass@3 in some cases but does not guarantee improvements in semantics or syntactic similarity.
This indicates that although it can generate syntactically correct code, it may occasionally overlook key information in the requirements.
The low absolute scores across most metrics also indicate that generating complete and semantically correct CSP# models remains a challenge.
While AST-based automated metrics are useful for evaluating structural similarity, they are approximations of semantic correctness.
However, the synthesized codes have limited complexity.
The performance improvements observed with NL2CSP may not generalize well to more challenging tasks, such as the model generation task.
To mitigate this limitation, we conduct a human review and investigate the correlation between automated metrics and human review metrics.
Online discussions among the reviewers are organized to reach a consensus on the evaluation criteria, ensuring the reliability and consistency of the human review.
Only syntactically correct codes are retained for further training.
citacoes.localizador: Seção V, item 3, p. 5 do PDF

citacoes.trecho: For each process and model, the experimental results are averaged across three runs with different random seeds.
In addition to automated metrics, we perform a human review of a randomly selected 20% of the generated codes.
GPT-4o significantly outperforms the others, achieving a pass rate of 0.6009, 3.5926 on Sufficiency, and 3.0535 on Semantic Correctness.
GPT-4o outperforms other LLMs in both zero-shot and 3-shot settings, exhibiting its capability to generate processes in CSP#.
In addition, none of these models shows the ability to generate complete syntactically correct processes.
Specifically, NL2CSP achieves a Pass@3 rate of 0.4889, significantly higher than GPT-4o (0.1556) and Qwen2.5-Coder (0.0222) in the 3-shot setting.
In particular, the Pass@3 metric doubles in the process generation task and increases nearly tenfold in the model generation task.
Tree Similarity (TRS) also provides the metrics to measure the similarity between two ASTs using tree edit distance.
It computes the percentage of subtrees in the candidate AST that are also present in the reference AST.

To investigate the correlations between automated and human review metrics proposed in Section VI-B, we calculate the Pearson Correlation Coefficient [46] for the results of GPT-4o, as shown in Fig. 3.
We evaluate the baseline models and our approach on the CSP#-Handwrite-45 dataset.

extracoes.selecao_motivo: Sem principal declarado: o estudo destaca várias métricas (automáticas e humanas) e vários modelos sem que um prevaleça, e sua proposta principal (NL2CSP) é pacote híbrido. A primeira tabela com contraste de prompting elegível é a Tabela II; primeira métrica pertinente (AST Match), primeiro modelo listado (GPT-4o) e primeira linha de base de prompting (zero-shot). Não há outra técnica focal de prompting com contraste comparável (NL2CSP em so_classificadas), nem outra tarefa do escopo, nem tabela de ablação ou contraste pareado de componente de prompting; a geração de modelos (Tabela III) é nova condição da mesma técnica e tarefa e não conta como cobertura.

qualidade.justificativa: O estudo declara o objetivo de explorar LLMs para transformar requisitos em linguagem natural em CSP# e lista as contribuições (conjuntos, tarefas de benchmark com linhas de base, NL2CSP e relação entre métricas automáticas e revisão humana).

Descreve conjuntos, tarefas, seleção dos exemplos, decodificação, número de execuções e etapas do NL2CSP, mas não apresenta os prompts de avaliação, não informa se o zero-shot inclui as regras de gramática nem o número de instâncias avaliadas por tarefa.

Há comparador zero-shot executado para os mesmos modelos e linha de base Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct (3-shot) para o NL2CSP, mas a composição do prompt zero-shot não é descrita e a linha de base do NL2CSP aparece só em figura sem valores; as comparações do NL2CSP nas tabelas envolvem backbones diferentes.
